description: Minified source code for bootstrap-datepicker plugin version 1.5.0, providing datepicker functionality for Bootstrap framework, including initialization, configuration, and rendering logic.

methods.name: _process_options
methods.description: Processes and applies configuration options for the datepicker instance, including start/end dates, view modes, and localization.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the datepicker display based on current selected dates and configuration.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Renders the calendar UI, including days, months, and years, based on current view and date range.

methods.name: setDaysOfWeekDisabled
methods.description: Disables specific days of the week.

methods.name: setDaysOfWeekHighlighted
methods.description: Highlights specific days of the week.

methods.name: fillDow
methods.description: Fills the day-of-week headers in the calendar.

methods.name: updateNavArrows
methods.description: Updates the visibility of navigation arrows based on current view and date range.
